name: Big Daddy's Restaurant
address: 8 Grave St, Mossel Bay Central, Mossel Bay, 6505, South Africa
description_short: Casual American-style dining in Mossel Bay Central with burgers, pizzas and family-friendly vibes.
description_long:
Big Daddy's Restaurant brings classic American comfort food to the heart of Mossel Bay Central. Located on Grave Street, this laid-back spot has become a local favourite for families and groups looking for generous portions without breaking the bank.

The menu covers all the bases with flame-grilled burgers, hand-stretched pizzas, and proper milkshakes that keep the kids happy while parents tuck into hearty platters. The casual atmosphere works equally well for a quick lunch between beach visits or a relaxed dinner after exploring the harbour.

With over a thousand Google reviews and a solid reputation for consistent quality, Big Daddy's delivers exactly what it promises — satisfying meals in a no-fuss setting that welcomes everyone from solo travellers to large family gatherings.
